fn-naming-check.desc: Checks that every private (non-`pub`) top-level function and inherent-impl method has a name starting with `_`, per the project's private-fn convention. Public functions/methods are unaffected.

exemption.item: Methods inside `impl Trait for Type` blocks are exempt, since their names are dictated by the trait.
Methods inside a `trait` definition are exempt, since trait items carry no visibility modifier of their own.
`fn main` is exempt, since the name is fixed by the language.
